subject.title: [Feature] Re-enable dev channel distribution tag for npm releases

question: Should OpenClaw publish a moving-main npm `dev` dist-tag, or should the documented dev path be kept git-only and the npm `dev` wording retired?
rationale: The requested change touches package distribution and dist-tag control, and the current release design deliberately separates OIDC publish from token-based dist-tag mutation.

options.title: Keep dev git-only
options.body: Update docs to remove the implied npm `dev` selector and leave `openclaw update --channel dev` as the supported moving-main checkout path.

options.title: Design npm dev snapshots
options.body: Add an explicitly approved release workflow for moving-main snapshot versions, dist-tag mutation, provenance, registry readback, rollback, and tests.

recommendation.title: Keep dev git-only
recommendation.body: Update docs to remove the implied npm `dev` selector and leave `openclaw update --channel dev` as the supported moving-main checkout path.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent blame and prior issue discussion put him closest to the release workflow/docs policy choice.
